signal: Qualia added Axos Bank to its Bank Partner Network in January 2026, expanding its digital closing footprint

email.body1:
Amelia, saw Qualia brought Axos Bank into its Bank Partner Network to push deeper into digital closings.

Expansion like that usually means more target accounts than your SDRs can follow up on at the speed deals need. Reps burn their day on research, writing, and CRM instead of live conversations. Our AI SDR runs that end to end, so follow-up volume scales without new hires, around 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body2:
Amelia, quick follow-up for Qualia.

For SDR teams, ramp time and response speed are usually where pipeline quietly leaks: leads go cold before a rep gets to them, and new hires take months to produce. Adding bodies doesn't fix the speed problem.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best-practice patterns alone tend to lift response rates 50-70%, and I'll show where Qualia's sequence is likely losing replies.
email.body3:
Amelia, last bit of proof for Qualia.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Qualia's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B software teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Amelia, I'll stop reaching out here, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding up SDR follow-up and ramp isn't the priority this quarter, totally fair. I know managing a development team leaves little room for new tools mid-cycle.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an SDR motion like yours? I'll tailor it to Qualia either way, and you keep it regardless.
